title: Input schema of the Pinterest "Aesthetic" Downloader Scraper

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Pinterest board, search, or profile URLs to start from (e.g. https://www.pinterest.com/search/pins/?q=aesthetic). Use JSON/endpoint URLs if available.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max requests per crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of HTTP requests the crawler will make.

maxPinsPerStartUrl.title: Max pins per start URL
maxPinsPerStartUrl.description: Limit number of pins to extract per start URL.

downloadImages.title: Download images
downloadImages.description: If true, download image files to the default Key-Value store (recommended).

imageKeyPrefix.title: KV image key prefix
imageKeyPrefix.description: Prefix used for keys when saving images to the Key-Value store.

pinLinkSelector.title: Pin link CSS selector
pinLinkSelector.description: Optional CSS selector to find pin links on search/board pages. The starter uses common fallbacks.

userAgent.title: User-Agent header (optional)
userAgent.description: Custom User-Agent for requests. Use a descriptive UA to be polite.
